about_text: Computer Science undergraduate at IIIT Nagpur with proven experience in talent coordination, resource planning, cross-functional collaboration, and data analysis. Google Student Ambassador, GDG Co-Lead, and founder of a student organisation. Brings extreme ownership, a seeker mindset, and passionate work ethic to every role.
